en: Adds UI scaling (100-125%) and fixes 125% layouts
Wi-Fi: serialized radio commands, silent reconnect, readable failures
PDF engine is now decoupled; update it from Settings if asked
Reading core font tiers (3,500 / 8,105 characters) ship in the data packs
Ordinary OTA is back; 0.7.0 and older still need a full install
Language pack grew to 1,879 keys: update it with this version
zh: 新增界面缩放（100–125%）并修复 125% 布局
Wi-Fi：射频命令串行化、静默重连、失败原因可读
PDF 引擎改为解耦，需要时在设置里更新引擎
阅读核心字体分档（3,500 / 8,105 字）随数据包发布
恢复普通 OTA；0.7.0 及更早版本仍需完整安装
语言包增至 1,879 键，请随本版本一起更新
